text: Hi. Do you still have the spare keys to the old flat? The landlord wants them back before the end of the month and I can't find mine.
hey. i think they're in the drawer by the door, in the bag i never unpack lol. let me check
found them. 2 keys + the small one for the cellar
All three, good. Can you drop them at mine, or should I come to Villeurbanne?
im on tomorrow at 7 so i cant do tomorrow. can you come thursday? i'm off thurs
Thursday works. What time suits you?
sorry was in the shower. after 2 thurs?
2 is fine. I'll confirm Thursday morning.
ok 👍
did he say anything about the deposit or just the keys
Didn't say anything about the deposit. Only the keys and the end of the month. I'll ask when I confirm Thursday.
Do you remember if the inventory was signed before we moved out or after?
before. we did it together on the 28th. i have the copy somewhere
ill look tonight if i'm not too dead
No rush. Thursday is the deadline for the keys anyway.
Agency says the deposit goes back within a month of the inventory, through them. They'll send a figure Thursday. I'll bring the keys and get it in writing.
ok. yeah get it in writing. last time they lost a whole envelope lol
i found the copy btw, its in the blue folder with the insurance stuff. i'll leave it on the table for you
Thanks. Keep it there. I'll take a photo of it before I leave on Thursday.
is the cellar key the small brass one or the silver one
Small brass one. The silver ones are for the front door.
Can you check page 2 of the inventory for the meter readings? I want to be sure they're on it before Thursday.
no idea. its like 6 pages lol. ill check tonight
ill be up for 2 thurs dont worry. ill put the coffee on
Ok. I'll bring the keys in a bag so they don't get lost on the way.
did u see the rain. tram 3 was a mess this evening
